scope: Schema-and-scenario coverage only. Expected outputs are synthetic and encode the STRUCTURE/FORMAT rules documented in the Juno PM changelog (card fields, confidence bands, priority values, citation format, PRD sections, mode-switching logic, staleness behavior). They are NOT validated against real Lovable AI Gateway / Gemini outputs and should not be used to judge synthesis QUALITY — only whether the app's rendering, state, and schema logic behave as documented.

schema.category: insight_synthesis | prd_generation | mode_switching | ui_state | citation_traceability | enhancement

input.existing_card: object or null (for enhancement/edit test cases)

input.transcript: User: I keep losing my place when I switch between the transcript view and the insights panel. Every time I scroll down in one, the other resets to the top. It's disorienting during long review sessions.
input.strategy_doc: Focus Q3: reduce friction in the core review workflow. Prioritize anything that breaks reviewer flow-state over net-new features.

insight_card.title: Scroll position resets between panels during review
insight_card.description: Reviewer loses scroll context when switching focus between transcript and insights panels, breaking flow during long sessions.
insight_card.evidence_quote: Every time I scroll down in one, the other resets to the top.
